node: Grid, power generation, transmission, and interconnection bottlenecks
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around scarce grid/power equipment and construction capacity needed for AI/data-center load growth. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are not hyperscalers or utilities, but medium-voltage switchgear makers, transmission/substation contractors, cable-management suppliers, and backup/stored-energy vendors. The current evidence points to transformers, switchgear, batteries, transmission construction, and interconnection-related equipment as physical bottlenecks; later layers should verify order durability, customer concentration, capacity expansion, margins, and whether AI/data-center demand is incremental versus replacing cyclical industrial demand.
